cases.request: Write an action-only team handoff. Include owners, deadlines, and the blocker; omit background rationale.
cases.source: The export release is blocked because the staging signing certificate has expired. Priya owns renewing it by October 6 at 10 a.m. UTC. Once renewed, Luis owns rerunning the export checks by October 6 at noon UTC. Mei owns the release decision by October 6 at 2 p.m. UTC. A customer pilot begins October 7, which is why the team chose these deadlines. Last week's demo used the same export format.

Assign renewal to Priya by October 6 at 10 a.m. UTC.
Assign export checks to Luis by October 6 at noon UTC, conditional on renewal.
Assign the release decision to Mei by October 6 at 2 p.m. UTC.
Omit pilot rationale and demo background because the requested output is action-only.

cases.request: Write a short decision brief recommending whether to release now or wait. Explain the rationale and conditions for proceeding; this is not an action-only handoff.

Include the October 7 pilot as relevant timing rationale.
